featured.title: A 5-account laundering ring
featured.blurb: Money went u_11720 → u_27627 → u_25278 → u_17815 → u_10921 → u_11720 in 1 minute. The engine flagged 4 of 5 transfers, from transfer 2 on, before the ring closed.

featured.title: Chennai, then Mumbai, 90 seconds later
featured.blurb: The same card paid again 90 seconds later, 1,033 km away in Mumbai: 41,312 km/h. The model scored it 0.9998.

featured.title: 19 payments in a minute
featured.blurb: The one-minute limit is 8; this account hit 19. The model scored it 0.9996.

featured.title: A payment to a sanctioned merchant
featured.blurb: m_CRYPTO_0013 is on the sanctions list, so the engine blocks it outright, whatever the model thinks.
